settings.headline:
Let childhood
unfold at its own pace.
settings.copy: Willow & Sage is a Montessori school for children ages 3 to 12, where curiosity leads, independence grows, and every child learns the way they learn best. Small classes, prepared environments, and guides who know each child by name.

trust_list.text: A 1.5-acre campus with gardens and woods

stats.label: Of families re-enroll the following year

settings.title: The child is
settings.intro: We don't teach to a test. We prepare an environment and let each child's natural curiosity do the rest — with a guide nearby to observe, support, and step back at just the right moment.

features.title: Prepared environments
features.text: Every classroom is arranged so children can choose their own work, move freely, and return materials to their place — building order, focus, and independence from the very first day.

features.title: Mixed-age classrooms
features.text: Children stay with the same guide for three years, learning from older peers and mentoring younger ones. It's how real social skills and deep relationships grow.

features.title: Hands-on materials
features.text: From the pink tower to the golden beads, our materials make abstract ideas tangible. Children don't memorize math — they hold it, build it, and understand it.

features.title: Uninterrupted work cycles
features.text: A three-hour morning work period lets children enter deep concentration and finish what they start — the foundation of focus and self-discipline for life.

features.title: Freedom within limits
features.text: Children choose their work, but within a clear, consistent structure. They learn that freedom and responsibility are two sides of the same coin.

features.title: Nature every day
features.text: Our campus includes gardens, a small orchard, and a wooded trail. Children spend real time outdoors in every season, learning to notice and care for the living world.
features.detail: Gardens, orchard, and woods on campus

settings.title: Three classrooms,
settings.intro: From the first day of Children's House to the end of Upper Elementary, Willow & Sage offers an unbroken Montessori journey — each stage preparing the child for the next.

design.title: Ages 3–6
design.text: Practical life, sensorial, language, and math — the foundations of independence, concentration, and a lifelong love of learning.

design.title: A gentle start
design.text: A gradual, family-centered entry that helps each child settle in at their own pace, with a guide who knows them by name.

build.title: Ages 6–9
build.text: Reading, writing, and the beginnings of abstract math, geography, and science — all through hands-on materials and real questions.

build.title: The great stories
build.text: The five Great Lessons open the universe to children — from the birth of the Earth to the story of writing and numbers.

launch.title: Ages 9–12
launch.text: Research, collaboration, and going-out — children plan their own studies, manage projects, and take learning beyond the classroom walls.

launch.title: Ready for the world
launch.text: By the end of Upper Elementary, children are confident, self-directed learners, ready to thrive in any middle school.

settings.title: A rhythm that
settings.intro: The day moves between deep work, community, and the outdoors — a rhythm that respects each child's need for concentration, connection, and movement.

steps.title: Morning arrival
steps.text: Children arrive, greet their guide, and settle into the classroom. Coats hung, shoes changed, ready for the day.

steps.title: The work cycle
steps.text: A three-hour uninterrupted work period. Children choose their work, concentrate deeply, and finish what they start.

steps.title: Community & lunch
steps.text: A shared lunch where children serve themselves, pour their own water, and practice grace and courtesy with one another.

steps.title: Outdoor time
steps.text: Gardens, the orchard, or the woods — real time outside in every season, rain or shine, with a guide nearby.

steps.title: Afternoon & dismissal
steps.text: A shorter afternoon cycle, then a calm dismissal. After-school care runs until 5:30 for families who need it.

settings.note: Parents often tell us the same thing: their child comes home calmer, more capable, and more themselves than when they started.

settings.title: Heard from
settings.intro: We don't make promises we can't keep. We let the children — and their parents — speak for us.

reviews.quote: My daughter started at three, barely speaking in class. By five she was reading chapter books and teaching her little brother. Willow & Sage didn't push her — they just let her bloom.
reviews.author: Amara Okafor

reviews.quote: The mixed-age classroom changed everything for my son. He's the youngest, and the older kids look out for him. He's learned patience, kindness, and how to ask for help.
reviews.author: Daniel Reyes

reviews.quote: We toured five schools. Only Willow & Sage asked what our child was curious about. Three years later, that question still guides everything they do.
reviews.author: Hannah Lindqvist

settings.title: Come see
settings.intro: The best way to understand Montessori is to see it. Book a tour, meet our guides, and watch a classroom in motion — we'd love to host you.
